rules.title: KYC must not be rejected
rules.description: A rejected customer identity verification blocks credit approval.
rules.source_document: NB-KYC-001 — Customer Identification and KYC Policy

rules.title: KYC must be verified before approval
rules.description: Pending or incomplete verification requires manual review and remediation.
rules.source_document: NB-KYC-001 — Customer Identification and KYC Policy

rules.title: Required application documents must be present
rules.description: Identity, income, bank-statement, and signed application evidence is mandatory.
rules.source_document: NB-DOC-001 — Consumer Credit Required Documents Policy

rules.title: Submitted documents must be valid
rules.description: Expired or invalid evidence cannot support an automated credit decision.

rules.title: Post-loan DTI review threshold
rules.description: Post-loan debt-to-income above 40 percent requires manual affordability review.

rules.title: Post-loan DTI hard limit
rules.description: Post-loan debt-to-income above 50 percent is outside lending appetite.

rules.title: Risk class must remain inside credit appetite
rules.description: Risk class E is excluded from standard consumer-credit approval.

rules.title: Temporary employment stability
rules.description: Temporary employees require at least twelve months of documented continuity.

rules.title: Consumer-credit amount limit
rules.description: Standard consumer-credit applications may not exceed EUR 75000.

rules.title: Standard term limit
rules.description: Terms above 84 months require an exception review.
